main_text.p: cundiæ abūdè promouisset, casas tamen non reciperet, tempusque iam longum trâs curreret, & facere id uidere- tur, ne reliquû mercedis da- ret: capit cõsilium Protago- ras,ut tum existimabat, astu- tum. Petere institit ex pacto mercedem.Litem cum Eua- thlo contestatur. Et cum ad iudices conijciendæ consistē dæque causæ gratia uenisset, tũ Protagoras sic exorsus est: Disce, inquit,stultissime ado- lescens,utrōque id modo fo- re ut reddas, quod peto: si- ue contra te pronunciatum erit,siue pro te. page.notes: The "«" marks at the end of each line are printed line-end ornaments, not text, so they are left out. The fragment "si-" is read as "si-" with long s normalised. Bottom left has a small stain ("ᴥ") and no catchword. Doubtful: "consistē" (read as consistē, tilde kept as printed) and the tilde forms "cõsilium", "utrōque", "tũ", which are kept as printed.
